scope: Controlled nonlinear univariate curve-bank experiment, NOT an AMA001 rerun, deep KAN or LLM result; no canonical MA status changes
teacher_normalization: one RMS scalar over all training task outputs, no test statistics
learning_rate_selection: calibration validation MSE; one shared LR per matched group: shared pair, rank2/PCGrad/native-alias triple, all four private allocation variants; rank3/FiLM/independent separate; minimum mean group score across all families/worlds; lower LR breaks ties
optimizer: Adam, beta1=.9 beta2=.999 epsilon=1e-8, no weight decay
batch: full training batch, all 8 tasks, equal loss weights
private_allocation: common 150-update rank2 mean-gradient prefix; highest two validation residual tasks or random two; all four private methods use identical prefix and reset Adam at fork; no true private IDs used
pcgrad: project each task's shared-parameter gradient against original other task gradients in seeded random order; average projected shared gradients; task-private gradients remain ordinary mean-loss gradients
oracle: QR-weighted truncated SVD from training labels only; rank0/rank2/rank3/selected-private/random-private/full; analytic objective lower bound, NOT a trained-model comparison

mechanism_gates.opposing_shared: nonzero task gradients cancel, shared and PCGrad cannot beat constrained oracle
mechanism_gates.zero_factor_trap: double-zero rank2 factors stall at mean curve; same rank with nonzero axes learns aligned task (fresh median test MSE <1e-3)
mechanism_gates.rank_boundary: every trained result >= its empirical class oracle within 1e-9; unrelated rank2 class oracle > aligned rank2 class oracle in all worlds
mechanism_gates.pcgrad_value: separate per-family paired effects for identical capacity/initialization; practical benefit needs >=5% median worst-task MSE improvement and <=1% mean-MSE degradation in >=4/5 world averages
mechanism_gates.selective_private: same-budget selected vs random allocation; >=5% worst-task improvement in >=4/5 partial world averages, no claimed gradient-only attribution
mechanism_gates.mirror_specific: FAIL by exact native-lowrank alias unless output/optimization/storage differ; no renaming gain allowed

fresh_policy: fresh is opened only after tests, calibration LR selection and source lock; run all predeclared methods regardless of calibration scientific outcome because purpose is causal audit, not adoption promotion; no retuning or early stopping
compute: container CPU only; NumPy float64 single-thread; exact manual derivatives checked against PyTorch autograd; equal steps are NOT equal work; record prefix cost and wall time
storage: lossless float64 inference codec, all basis/grid metadata, factors, task IDs, private indices included; native alias shares identical inference format; no optimizer or teacher data in inference
uncertainty: report per-world averages of 3 initializations, five-world paired effects, world-cluster bootstrap 95% descriptive intervals; not a powered confirmatory natural-task study
